outcome: mRNA/protein expression of key regulators of FA metabolism pathways
cohort: The study included placentas and mother-baby-placenta triads from lean and obese women with normal glucose tolerance, recruited at scheduled term Cesarean delivery.
finding: Placentas of obese women had higher lipid content and increased FA esterification rates, coupled with decreased mitochondrial FA oxidation capacity but increased peroxisomal FA oxidation, suggesting an adaptive mechanism to limit fetal lipid transfer.
